gnosh prompt context

  Print what fills the context window, by category. With neither -s nor -C,
  what a new session would start with.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh prompt context [flags]

Flags
  -s, --session <id>
      Show what fills the context window of the session with this ID.
  -c, -C, --continue
      Show it for the most recent session of this project.
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -D, --data-dir <dir>
      Keep sessions and data in this folder instead of the project's own.
      Commands that read them look there too.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
